name: compdb-clangxx-msvc-i686-windows-h
description: Issue #100, the report's own shape: a module whose global module fragment includes <Windows.h>, compiled for i686-pc-windows-msvc (--target=i686-pc-windows-msvc), where winnt.h's Int64ShllMod32 family uses __asm blocks under _M_IX86. The fixture first builds the module with the machine's clang++ as the project does (the report's CLI build), then the server reads the compile_commands.json it wrote. With the engine of 0.24.1 the module did not build ("MS-style inline assembly is not available: target MC unavailable") and its importer lost it.
